NONE: › used to mean "whatever you are going to do" or "whatever you think"
不管你要做甚麼；不管你怎麼想

example: I don't know about you, but I'm going to bed.
不管你怎麼想，我去睡覺了。

NONE: › used to add force to criticisms, expressions of surprise, etc.
（用於加強批評、驚訝等的語氣）真沒想到，真不知道

example: I don't know how you can eat that revolting stuff!
天知道你怎麼吃得下那麼噁心的東西！
I don't know why you bother.
真不知道你為何要操心。

NONE: › used to express that you do not understand or are angry at something that someone has done
（表示不理解或惱火）我不明白

example: I don't know, however many notices I put up, people still park in my space.
我不明白，不管我貼了多少告示，人們還是在我的車位泊車。

NONE: › said to politely accept an offer of food or drink
（用於禮貌地接受）可以吃點，可以喝些

example: "There's plenty more cake if you'd like another piece." "I don't mind if I do."
「如果你想再吃一塊，這裡還有很多蛋糕呢。」「那我就不客氣了。」

NONE: › said to mean that you do not believe someone can do something

example: He said women have an easier life than men, did he? - I'd like to see him bring up children and go to work at the same time.
「他說女人比男人活得更輕鬆，是不是？－－我倒想看看他怎樣一邊撫養孩子一邊工作。」
